chapters.label: Live: the Euro 2022 quarter-final
chapters.text: Euro 2022, the quarter-final against Finland. Afonso Jesus, Portugal’s fixo, scores early. Finland equalise, then Afonso scores again! Two one!

chapters.label: Into the semi-final
chapters.text: Final whistle: three two! Portugal are into the semi-final, and they go on to win Euro 2022!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: His card move is the last-man block. Watch how he does it. An attacker runs at goal, and Afonso is the last defender. He stays on his feet, gets his body in line, and blocks the shot!

chapters.label: Practise it
chapters.text: Your turn: stay on your feet, get in line, and block it with your body!
